grievance_text: The municipal water supply has stopped for three days in our ward and tankers have not arrived.
A sewage line is overflowing near the government school and dirty water is entering homes.
The handpump in our village is broken and residents have no drinking water.
The road from the bus stand to the hospital is full of deep potholes and unsafe at night.
The city bus did not stop at the designated stop and the route has become unreliable.
A traffic signal is not working at the main junction and several near collisions have occurred.
Our neighbourhood has repeated power cuts and the transformer is making sparks.
The electricity meter is showing incorrect readings and the complaint has not been resolved.
A fallen power line is blocking the lane and poses an immediate danger to residents.
The primary health centre has no doctor for several weeks and patients are being turned away.
The government hospital is overcrowded and essential medicines are unavailable.
Please arrange an ambulance and urgent medical support for an injured person at the roadside.
A group is burning plastic waste beside the market and thick smoke is affecting children.
Industrial discharge is polluting the river and fish are dying near the village.
Garbage has not been collected for two weeks and the colony has a severe mosquito problem.
A stolen motorcycle was reported yesterday and the local police station has not registered the complaint.
There is a violent fight outside the railway station and people need immediate police assistance.
Streetlights are not working and repeated chain snatching is making the road unsafe.
A woman facing domestic violence needs immediate protection and access to a shelter.
A child labourer is working at a roadside shop and needs intervention from child protection officers.
The anganwadi centre in our area has been closed and children are missing nutrition services.
My pension application has been pending for six months and I need help from the social welfare office.
An elderly person living alone has no food or medicines and needs a welfare visit.
The disability certificate support desk is not accepting applications from eligible residents.
The government school has no usable toilets and students are being forced to leave campus.
Scholarship payments have not reached eligible students despite repeated verification.
A teacher vacancy has left the high school without science classes for the entire term.
The municipal birth certificate portal is failing and residents cannot download certificates.
Street cleaning and drain maintenance have not been done before the monsoon in our ward.
The property tax payment counter is closed during published working hours.
A land mutation request has been pending at the tehsil office and the records still show the previous owner.
There is an encroachment on government land and the survey request has not been acted on.
Please correct the spelling of my name in the revenue record and explain the required documents.
Crops were damaged by unseasonal rain and farmers need an inspection for compensation.
The village irrigation canal is blocked and farmers cannot water their fields.
The agriculture extension officer has not visited the cluster to distribute the approved seed information.
Our ration shop is refusing to provide the monthly wheat quota recorded on our ration cards.
The biometric machine at the fair price shop is not working and families are being denied food grains.
Please investigate diversion of subsidised kerosene from the public distribution outlet.
I need general information about applying for a residential parking permit and the required documents.
Please explain the eligibility and application process for a government scholarship.
I would like the office address and working hours for submitting a birth certificate request.
The ward office has not restored the public tap and residents are buying drinking water.
A manhole is overflowing beside the market and pedestrians are exposed to sewage.
The village road has broken completely after the monsoon and ambulances cannot pass.
Auto-rickshaws are refusing the permitted fare and blocking the hospital entrance.
The feeder has failed and the whole block has been without electricity since last night.
A damaged electricity pole is leaning over houses and must be secured.
The district clinic is refusing free tests promised under the public health programme.
A child with a high fever needs urgent care but the nearest health centre is closed.
Open waste is being dumped beside the lake and the smell is affecting the settlement.
Dust from an uncovered construction site is causing breathing problems in nearby homes.
Unknown people are threatening shopkeepers and residents need police patrolling.
A missing child was last seen near the bus terminal and the family needs police help.
A survivor of abuse needs counselling, legal support, and safe accommodation.
The local child-care centre has no food supplies for the registered children.
Widow pension payments have stopped even though the beneficiary completed verification.
A homeless family needs temporary shelter and assistance accessing welfare benefits.
The school roof leaks during rain and classrooms have become unsafe for students.
The college has not issued certificates despite students completing the required course.
The municipal road light has been off for a month and the ward complaint is pending.
The ward office has not removed a fallen tree blocking the public footpath.
A boundary dispute requires an official survey and correction in the land register.
The ownership details in the village record are incorrect after a recent sale.
Farmers need a field inspection after pests destroyed the cotton crop.
The rural development project has not built the approved check dam for irrigation.
The ration dealer is charging more than the printed price for subsidised grain.
Families are being asked for unofficial payments to release their monthly ration.
Can you tell me the helpline number for reporting a municipal water issue?
I need the application form and deadline for the district social-welfare scheme.
